module: Auxiliary hydraulic suspension controller (type "auxiliary"): drives the reference length of beams (suspension cylinders) grouped into named groups. A virtual pump limits the extension speed; lowering is done at a fixed speed; in "bleed" mode the beam is released (zero spring, variable damping) and follows freely. It also plays the pump and release sounds. A modder calls setGroupsPosition / setGroupsBleed / setGroupsMomentaryIncrease from inputs or other controllers.
usage:
local hs = controller.getControllerSafe('hydraulicSuspension')
hs.setGroupsPosition({"front", "rear"}, 1)   -- all the way up
hs.setGroupsBleed({"front"}, 1)              -- releases the front
notes: Controller jbeam keys: hydraulicBeams (name of the v.data table describing the beams, default "hydraulicsData"; each entry contains beamName, groupName, min, max), basePumpSpeed (0.5, length ratio change per second), maxPumpSpeed (default basePumpSpeed*20), pumpSample (sound event, default "event:>Vehicle>Hydraulics>Pump_01"), releaseSample (default "event:>Vehicle>Hydraulics>Release_01"), pumpNode (sound emission node).

jbeam keys carried by the beams: name (required to be found), hydraulicsMinDamp (0, minimum damping in bleed mode), defaultBleedCoef (1, bounded 0..1). Positions are ratios of the beam's reference length (obj:setBeamLengthRefRatio).

A beam in bleed mode (bleedCoef > 0) has a spring of 0; at bleedCoef = 0 it regains its original spring and original damping. Raising is limited by min(basePumpSpeed*speedCoef, maxPumpSpeed); lowering is done at 10 (ratio/s).
On reset all beams return to their original position with bleedCoef = 1 (released).
Non-existent group names are ignored with a warning in the log.
getState/setState save per beam: currentPosition, targetPosition, bleedCoef, speedCoef.

init.desc: Builds the beam groups from the jbeam hydraulic table, stores the pump parameters.

initSounds.desc: Creates the pump and release sound sources on pumpNode. Called by the controller manager during sound initialization.

resetSounds.desc: Resets the state of the pump and release sounds.

reset.desc: Returns all beams to their original position and to released mode.

updateFixedStep.desc: Every physics step: advances each beam toward its target position at the pump speed and applies the length and the spring/damping.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: handles the pump sound (volume 0.5, pitch depending on the flow) and the release sound according to the released beams that shorten.

setGroupsPosition.desc: Sets the target position of all named groups: position 0 = min extension, 1 = max extension of each beam. Disables the bleed of these beams.

groupNames.desc: Group names (groupName in the hydraulic table).

position.desc: 0..1, interpolation between min and max of each beam.

setGroupsBleed.desc: Releases the groups: bleedCoef > 0 removes the spring and lets the beam follow freely; the damping depends on 1 - bleedCoef.

setGroupsMomentaryIncrease.desc: Enables/disables the continuous increase of the groups' target (at the pump's base speed) as long as enabled is true, within the min/max limits of each beam.

getState.desc: Returns the state of all beams for saving/synchronization.

setState.desc: Restores the state returned by getState (valid numeric values only).
